test_item_verbatim: The user presses OK to confirm the change.

tcs.tc_title: pressing OK confirms the camera name change
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. A wired AUX camera is connected
3. The full QWERTY keyboard is shown for editing the camera name
4. A new name has been typed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press OK
2. Read the HU display and check that the pop-up has closed and the new name is in effect
tcs.expected_result:
1. OK registers the press
2. The name edit pop-up closes and the new name is in effect
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: pressing OK confirms the camera name change
